en.text: Article 10 — Dividends. The official Sweden–Czechoslovakia treaty, applied to the Czech Republic, provides no source-State tax where the recipient is a company with share capital that directly holds at least 25 per cent of the payer’s capital, and a 10 per cent ceiling in the other treaty case. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty provision; the official treaty text controls.

Article 11 — Interest. The official Sweden–Czechoslovakia treaty, applied to the Czech Republic, provides residence-State-only taxation for qualifying interest where the treaty conditions are met and there is no effective connection with a source-State permanent establishment. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty provision; the official treaty text controls.

Article 12 — Royalties. The official Sweden–Czechoslovakia treaty, applied to the Czech Republic, provides residence-State-only taxation for copyright royalties relating to literary, artistic or scientific works and a 5 per cent source-State ceiling for the other Article 12 royalty category, subject to the treaty-residence and no-effective-connection conditions. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty provision; the official treaty text controls.
